assertions.expected: After clean shutdown, a second actual Pi process reloads the extension and registers its bridge command.
assertions.observed: Second Pi process get_commands returned gstack-bridge:status and gstack-bridge:doctor.

assertions.expected: The reloaded extension in the second actual Pi process executes gstack_pi_agent, receives a successful actual child Pi response, and returns it to the parent.
assertions.observed: Second process tool result contained PI_GSTACK_SMOKE_RELOADED_OK, child exit_code=0; parent response contained PARENT_OBSERVED_RELOADED_CHILD_OK.

assertions.expected: Both sequential Pi RPC processes exit naturally with status 0 after stdin close; neither is killed to satisfy the check and no extension/unhandled/shutdown errors are observed.
assertions.observed: First process exit=0; second process exit=0; extension load errors=0; unhandled/shutdown errors=0.
